summary: Sprint M8 (Editable Tournament Calendar + Active Venues/Grounds) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 pass — venue+ground snapshot creation, cross-venue ground validation (400), invalid host (400), age_floor>age_cap (400), and seed counts (venues>=5, grounds>=8, bodies>=66). Frontend E2E flow works — office-bearer sees Add Tournament, modal has all 16 fields (5 type options), ground select is disabled until venue picked and then filters correctly by venue, tournament persists with venue+ground snapshot in the list row. Sidebar 'Venues & Grounds' is active under Operations and NOT in Coming Soon; /venues page loads with 5 venue cards. RBAC verified — district-secretary does NOT see the Add Tournament button.

issues: Host body dropdown lists all Districts as flat siblings under one long alphabetical list — 54 items becomes noisy. Consider grouping by <optgroup> body_type (State / Division / District) for readability.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Add <optgroup> in TournamentCreateModal host dropdown to group State / Division / District bodies (54+ districts is currently a flat list).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tournaments.py has a duplicate `_next_tournament_no` definition (imported from core.helpers on line 10, then redefined on line 16). The local redefinition wins and is used, but the import is dead code — clean up either the import or the local function to avoid confusion.

TournamentCreateModal.jsx allows saving with a truthy `form.host_body_id` but the select defaults to 'MPCA'; if bodies fetch fails silently (catch → []) the hostOptions list is empty AND the visible <select> still shows a placeholder 'MPCA' value. The save can go through with host_body_id='MPCA' which then gets validated backend-side — acceptable, but a UI-side error surface when bodies is empty would be friendlier.

Tournament model has no DELETE endpoint — E2E test tournaments cannot be cleaned via API (had to use direct mongo query). Consider adding DELETE /api/tournaments/{tid} restricted to Draft status for testability and to let users cancel bad entries.

React warning in console: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` — the emergent instrumentation wraps dynamic option text (venue category, ground type, host code) in a <span>. Non-blocking (dev-only) but noisy. Consider using plain string interpolation inside <option> or acknowledge as instrumentation artefact.
